shared_elements: repeated small units arranged in a regular row/series
quadruped animal in profile (in B) vs animal-head signs (in A) — only loosely comparable
justification: The only real correspondence is the presence of repeated small schematic units in ordered rows — a grid of glyph blocks in A versus the rank of crew strokes along a boat hull in B — which is a generic organisational trait rather than a shared motif. A is an entirely sign-based composition of framed cartouche-like blocks with no scene, whereas B depicts a specific pictorial subject: a manned boat with upcurved animal-headed prow and stern, plus a quadruped and other figures on open ground.
